headline: OpenRAC expands mod installation as Going Commando reports 7760 matched functions
summary: OpenRAC's development launcher gained mod browsing, dependency handling and automatic updates with rollback, alongside fixes for controls, Windows audio and rendering. Its stable branch received a PAL Enhanced lighting preparation fix. Going Commando reported 7760 of 8579 matched functions, while Deadlocked added PAL matches; matching means compiling to exactly the original game's bytes. Ratchet & Clank reorganised its source and moved more data into C while retaining its reported complete function match. Archipelago gained save-slot seed protection, and releases included Mod SDK 1.11.0, Archipelago 2.1.0, item randomizer 1.0.4 and difficulty 1.2.4.
